checks.rule: Every v2 draft JSON artifact parses successfully.
Every schema uses Draft 2020-12, has a stable v2.0-draft $id, and rejects additional top-level properties.
Every relative $ref and declared schema locator resolves inside v2.0-draft.
The accepted v1 root and v1 artifact bytes remain unchanged.
No v2 artifact claims to modify or replace v1 in place.
A local hash, HMAC, DPAPI file, Owner checkpoint, or test witness cannot claim complete suffix deletion detection.
Production rollback detection requires EXTERNAL_APPEND_ONLY or HARDWARE_MONOTONIC witness class.
Receipt binds the full anchor payload hash, witness identity, monotonic counter, previous receipt hash, signature algorithm, key id, and signature.
Ledger rollback, divergence, unanchored tail, unavailable witness, and uninitialized states fail closed for Research OS while preserving the core Warroom.
Only MATCHED permits normal governance projection.
Governance events allow OWNER and SYSTEM actors only; OpenAI, Codex, model, agent, and tool actors are forbidden.
Every state-changing Owner event requires an Owner authorization reference and required artifact bindings.
Governance ledger is append-only, RFC8785 canonicalized, hash-chained, externally anchored, and cannot update/delete/truncate records.
Genesis binds accepted v1 root, Git baseline commit, Phase 1B implementation commit, and a qualifying first receipt.
Projection is disposable and fully reconstructable from verified anchored records.
Architecture Review generated by a model remains a hashed candidate artifact until OWNER or SYSTEM records it; it has no authority by itself.
No event or policy can change formal CSV, Runtime SQLite, rules, HOLD, MIDR, IC scores, reports, trades, or positions.
No Runtime, provider connector, network access, credential, Launcher integration, or OpenAI capability is authorized by this draft.
Phase 2 remains blocked until v2 freeze/acceptance, qualifying witness tests, governance replay tests, implementation commit binding, and Owner acceptance complete.
The draft contains no Python, executable connector, API implementation, SDK dependency, or generated runtime state.

passCondition: All CRITICAL and HIGH checks PASS.
failureBehavior: Do not freeze v2, do not implement Phase 1B.5 Runtime, and keep Phase 2 blocked.
